name: Optiscan Imaging Limited
summary: Optiscan Imaging Limited engages in the development and commercialization of confocal endomicroscopic imaging technologies for medical, translational, and pre-clinical applications in Australia, North America, Europe, and Asia. It offers FIVE2 (ViewnVivo) system, a miniaturized fluorescence endomicroscope that brings imaging flexibility to preclinical research. The company also engages in the development of InVivage device for clinical use in the oral cancer and other cancer applications. Optiscan Imaging Limited was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Mulgrave, Australia.
